responses_en: Hello! I am AgriBot-CAR. Ask me anything about soil types, colors, or preparation.
responses_il: Naimbag a bigat! Siak ni AgriBot-CAR. Agdamag maipapan iti kita ti daga, maris, wenno panagsagana.

patterns: Ania ti kayat a sawen ti nangisit a daga?
responses_en: Dark or black soil usually indicates a high level of organic matter and carbon, which is excellent for planting.
responses_il: Ti nangisit a daga ket kadawyan a mangipakita ti adu a nabulok a mulmula ken carbon, a nasayaat unay a pagmulaan.

responses_en: Red soil usually means it is rich in iron oxide but might be older and less fertile. It often needs organic compost.
responses_il: Ti nalabbasit a daga ket masansan nga aduan iti iron oxide ngem baka nakurang iti sustansia. Masapulna ti compost.

responses_en: Sticky soil is usually heavy clay. It holds nutrients well but drains poorly. You can improve it by adding organic matter like rice hulls.
responses_il: Ti napigket a daga ket puro a luppo. Nasayaat a mangtengngel iti sustansia ngem narigat a maatianan. Nayunan iti nabulok a mulmula wenno taep.

responses_en: You're welcome! Wishing you a bountiful harvest.
responses_il: Agyamanak met! Sapay koma ta nasayaat ti apitmo.
